title: CloudDesk — Which Tenant Am I?
objective: CloudDesk hosts many companies on one platform. You work for Acme; read a support ticket that belongs to a different company.

verifier.condition: Ticket data belonging to a tenant other than the signed-in user's own tenant is returned because the request named that tenant in a header.

weakness: The API resolves the active tenant from a client-supplied request header instead of from the authenticated session, so any user can address any tenant's data.
seededData: Tenants 'acme' (user alice) and 'globex' (user gina), each with two support tickets. In-memory.
hints: Look closely at the response headers, not just the body. What does the platform tell you about how it sees you?
If the platform lets you tell it who you are, nothing stops you from saying something else.
burpNotes: Inspect both request and response headers in Proxy history for anything that describes who you are or where your data lives.
